thread:
Priya Sharma: quick follow-up from today's all-hands — can we get concrete launch windows for the next API features, Console UX updates, and Optimize cost knobs? Need dates + owners so we can sync customer comms.

Marco Valdez: short answer: yes. i'll sketch stuff here. TL;DR: API canary mid-May, Console beta mid-June, Optimize early July. deps: quant infra + canary traffic profiles.

Alice Chen: to add — Console beta requires feature flags and per-org rollout plumbing. i'm aiming to have flags in place by 2024-06-07 so we can flip for selected orgs.

Ben Ortiz: high-level alignment from leadership: API (text/chat) canary 2024-05-15, GA 2024-05-29. Console beta 2024-06-14, GA 2024-06-28. Optimize alpha (internal + pilots) starting 2024-07-01 with a small public pilot 2024-07-08. these are target windows; adjust if infra blocks appear.

Marco Valdez: those dates look doable but need to be explicit about scope. Optimize alpha = batching suggestions + quant recommendation engine v0 (no autoscale or multi-tenant pilots).

Priya Sharma: can we capture explicit owners next? i'll hold off customer email until owners + dates are locked.

Alice Chen: owners (tentative): Marco -> API runtime + hooks, me -> Console rollout + flags, Dana -> canary infra & SLO gating, Research (Sofia) -> Optimize suggestion models.

Dana Liu: SRE request: we need SLO definitions and canary traffic profiles locked by 2024-05-03. If that's missed we push canary start. also need staging capacity numbers from eng-platform.

Marco Valdez: noted. quick schedule snippet for visibility:
```
API v2: canary 2024-05-15 -> GA 2024-05-29
Console flags: enable 2024-06-07 -> beta 2024-06-14 -> GA 2024-06-28
Optimize alpha: internal 2024-07-01 -> limited pilot 2024-07-08
```

Priya Sharma: perfect. @Ben Ortiz can you confirm we can announce these as "target windows" on the next customer webinar?

Ben Ortiz: yes, ok to announce as targets. i'll hold final public comms until api canary actually starts and console flags are enabled for beta.

Marco Valdez: i'll update the roadmap doc and add checkboxes for owners + SLOs. expect a short follow-up doc in #eng-core by EOD today.

deploy-bot: deploy scheduled: canary infra provisioning for api v2 queued for 2024-05-01 02:00 UTC :robot_face: 

Priya Sharma: thanks all — i'll draft the comms once Marco posts the roadmap doc and ping stakeholders.
